recipe.text: One run_luau call builds the whole menu: full-screen dark backdrop (14,16,20), a centered rounded panel (AnchorPoint 0.5 at scale 0.5) holding a UIListLayout stack of title, subtitle, and two 52px-tall TextButtons. Buttons differ by role: primary Play is accent blue with a lighter stroke, Settings is neutral dark. Gotham family fonts throughout for readability; UIPadding keeps content off the panel edges.
